prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed at intake. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, and imaging findings clearly support the clinical diagnosis. There is no known prior injury to the lumbar region in the records reviewed. Care consisted of 17 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Treatment followed a typical course, with pain scores and mobility steadily improving and visit frequency tapering as recovery progressed. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was released to full activity with a home exercise program. Separately, the billing review notes two similar charges submitted on the same date of service, which are currently being verified with the billing office.
